programs.title: Vanished in an Instant
programs.desc: Megan's teenage daughter, Whitney, disappears after their car breaks down at a gas station. As a shadowy figure traps Whitney in a deadly game of survival, Megan scrambles to uncover the truth before she's lost forever.

programs.title: Gaslit by My Husband: The Morgan Metzer Story
programs.desc: After a masked intruder assaults Morgan Metzer in her home, her ex-husband, Rodney, shows up minutes later. Questioned by the authorities, Rodney's story doesn't seem to add up, making him the prime suspect in the attack.

programs.title: Fame: A Temptations Story
programs.desc: Despite sibling rivalry, the Jordan sisters, Cherish and Roxy, remain the hottest singing duo on the charts. When their penthouse becomes the target of a jewel heist, rumors start to spread that Roxy secretly planned and staged the crime.

programs.title: A Hundred Lies
programs.desc: Ricky is a musician from Toronto, and he needs to support his mother who is in a long-term care home. His co-worker Damian connects him with Reaper, an underground urban music producer, and his career skyrockets; but everything comes for a price.
